title: Anthropic CEO calls for global AI slowdown to prevent internet ‘swarm’ threat
summary: After years of rapid development in artificial intelligence, one of the most prominent voices in AI says the industry needs to hit the brakes.

title: Sam Altman backs Anthropic over slowing down AI development; vows to follow Amodei's proposal; Musk follows suit
summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and billionaire Elon Musk backed Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s call to slow AI development and said OpenAI would adopt a proposed safeguard, as Anthropic researchers warned of risks from increasingly powerful AI systems.

title: Anthropic C.E.O. Dario Amodei Calls for A.I. Slowdown
summary: In an essay, the head of Anthropic laid out the rapidly advancing capabilities of artificial intelligence and said there needed to be greater safety controls across the industry.
author: Mike Isaac

title: Bernie Sanders echoes Dario Amodei and Sam Altman on slowing down development, urges ban on superintelligent AI
summary: US Senator Bernie Sanders has urged Donald Trump and Xi Jinping to negotiate a treaty to pause advanced AI development and ban superintelligent AI. His call follows concerns raised by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and xAI chief Elon Musk over the rapid pace of AI development.

title: AI Startup Discovery Loop, founded by former Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean, seeks to raise funds at $50 bn valuation
summary: Discovery Loop, founded by former Google chief scientist Jeff Dean, is seeking funding at a $50 billion valuation. The AI startup aims to accelerate scientific research, backed by major investors and a team of Google veterans.

title: Live episode: how AI is reshaping our minds – podcast
summary: In this episode of Science Weekly, recorded in front of an audience at the London podcast festival on 3 September, Ian Sample hears from Michael Safi, the host of the Guardian’s chart-topping podcast about artificial intelligence, Black Box. In series two, Black Box: the chatbots, Michael meets people who have become convinced they have made scientific breakthroughs, cured diseases or invented new technologies using AI chatbots. Ian, Michael and Science Weekly’s co-host Madeleine Finlay explore the phenomenon labelled ‘AI psychosis’ and ask what it reveals about a technology now used by more than a billion people Listen to Black Box: the chatbots Support the Guardian: theguardian.com/sciencepod Continue reading...
author: Presented by Ian Sample, with Madeleine Finlay and Michael Safi; produced by Madeleine Finlay; executive producer Ellie Bury

title: Obama Urges Democrats to Move A.I. Oversight to the Center of Their Agenda
summary: During a private fund-raiser, the former president warned that the technology could be “dangerous” if not managed urgently and with a clear plan.
author: Evan Gorelick

title: Implementation of Machine Learning Workflows with NVIDIA cuML, RAPIDS, GPU Benchmarking, Explainability, Clustering, and Model Inference
summary: This practical tutorial demonstrates how to build and accelerate machine learning workflows using NVIDIA cuML and RAPIDS.
